name: Digital-secondary channel identity cross-reference
summary: Links the drawing channel names to the selected configuration and equipment documentation.
description: Links the drawing channel names to the selected configuration and equipment documentation. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Drawing signal identifiers” at the input and “Configuration channel references” at the output. Configuration revision must match the installation.
